dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things been going for you recently?

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Well, quite the same as always. I am the resident playwright and manager, and so I am... managing, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: We are a rather small troupe, so pretty much everyone other than Kourosh wears several hats. I also do some composing, choreography, stage design, and action direction on the side.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: However, we have had new joiners recently, which has given me some time to focus on something... And of course, one can't complain about the added bustle.
